beats.vo: Every morning, in thousands of classrooms, the same story begins.
A teacher draws a heart on the board. It is flat. It is dusty. And by the next period, it is gone.
Forty students. One explanation. A few follow. Most quietly drift away.
Minutes go on calling names, one by one.
And tonight, she'll plan tomorrow's lesson by hand. Again.
If a student misses a day, that lesson is simply lost.
What if the board on the wall could change all of that?
